steps.question: How does the elephant come?
options: swaying along with children singing a song
steps.answer: swaying along with children singing a song
steps.modelAnswer: The elephant comes swaying along with his cargo of children, all singing a song.

modelMeaning.hi: हाथी झूमता हुआ आता है, उसकी पीठ पर बच्चे गाना गा रहे हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haathi jhoomta hua aata hai, uski peeth par bachche gaana ga rahe hain.

steps.question: What is the cargo of the elephant?
steps.modelAnswer: The cargo of the elephant is children.

steps.question: What can the elephant do with its trunk?

questionMeaning.hi: हाथी अपनी सूँड से क्या कर सकता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Haathi apni soond se kya kar sakta hai?

options: root up an oak, pull down a house or pick up a pin
steps.answer: root up an oak, pull down a house or pick up a pin
steps.modelAnswer: With its trunk, the elephant can root up an oak tree, pull down a house or pick up a pin.

modelMeaning.hi: हाथी अपनी सूँड से बलूत का पेड़ उखाड़ सकता है, घर गिरा सकता है या एक पिन उठा सकता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haathi apni soond se baloot ka ped ukhaad sakta hai, ghar gira sakta hai ya ek pin utha sakta hai.

steps.question: What did the children do to the elephant?

questionMeaning.hi: बच्चों ने हाथी के साथ क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachchon ne haathi ke saath kya kiya?

options: They crowned him with may flowers.
steps.answer: They crowned him with may flowers.
steps.modelAnswer: The children crowned the elephant with may flowers.

modelMeaning.hi: बच्चों ने हाथी को फूलों का मुकुट पहनाया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bachchon ne haathi ko phoolon ka mukut pehnaaya.

steps.sentence: He can pull down a house or pick up a pin.

meaning.hi: वह घर गिरा सकता है या एक पिन उठा सकता है।
meaning.hinglish: Woh ghar gira sakta hai ya ek pin utha sakta hai.
meaning.en: He can pull down a house or pick up a pin.
